Villa for Rent in Caya, Arabian Ranches 3.

Experience contemporary living in this beautifully designed 4-bedroom standalone villa located in the prestigious Caya community of Arabian Ranches 3. Set on a large single-row plot, this vacant home offers privacy, space, and elegance, perfect for modern family living.

Key Features:

• 4 spacious bedrooms, including a luxurious master suite
• Walking distance to the Amenities Center, Pool, Gym, Barbecue Area
• Large open-plan living and dining areas with ample natural light
• Modern kitchen with sleek finishes and ample storage
• Maid’s room and laundry area for added convenience
• Expansive plot offering a generous garden and outdoor space
• Covered parking for two vehicles
• Single-row location ensuring added privacy and peaceful surroundings
• Community amenities include parks, pools, gym, and more

Don't miss the opportunity to live in one of Dubai’s most sought-after family communities. This vacant villa is ready for immediate move-in. Contact Provident today to arrange your viewing and make this exceptional property your new home.
